name: LaunchVault

sources.title: Launch Vault homepage — launch platform with daily launch board and Umami-verified stats
Pricing — Free (verified dofollow backlink required) vs Premium $19.99 (marked down to $9.99)

conditions: Free launch requires adding a verified dofollow backlink to LaunchVault on your site — 'Verify in one click, then pick your launch date'
Premium $19.99/launch (displayed struck-through to $9.99) removes the backlink requirement, skips the free queue, and guarantees a permanent DR46 dofollow backlink
requirements: Launches happen at 8:00 AM UTC in daily batches ('limited number of projects each day')
Free-tier verification is a real dofollow link, one-click verified
preparation: Project name, URL, description, categories (very broad taxonomy incl. SaaS, AI, dev tools, edtech, fintech, health)
Logo and long description (launches display multi-paragraph copy)
Dofollow link to launchvault.dev placed on your site for the free route, or $9.99–19.99 for Premium
workflow: Choose Free (place + verify the dofollow backlink) or Premium (pay, skip queue)
Save the project privately before launch if desired
Pick a launch date; the project goes live at 8:00 AM UTC on the homepage board
watchFor: Free plan demands a *dofollow* backlink to them — stronger than a badge image; the link must pass their checker
Premium price shown as '$9.99 $19.99' — strike-through sale pricing, treat the real charge as shown at checkout
Sponsor slots (Hero $79/mo, Sidebar $39/mo) are separate paid upsells
Site is 'Powered by Open-Launch' — same engine family as several other boards, expect similar mechanics
Pricing copy leans hard on FOMO ('Every week you wait is a week of search traffic')
countsAsLive: Project appears in 'Top Projects Launching Today' on launchvault.dev on its launch date with its own listing page Google can index
unknowns: Length of the free queue ('launch in days, not months' for paid implies the free queue is long)
Whether free listings persist permanently like paid ones
